prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium collectible weapon trophy for a Korean fantasy RPG player-card trophy cabinet. Create a single Frostmourne (the Lich King's sword, 서리한) trophy for 1000 successful Lich King clears. The whole sword is the trophy: long heavy straight silver-gray runeblade with an icy blue engraved central channel, jagged serrated angular blade edges, iconic horned skull crossguard with cold blue eyes, black wrapped grip and pointed skull pommel. Blade points down and its very tip is planted in a compact crystalline ice crown on a low black obsidian and silver octagonal trophy pedestal. An elegant deadly monumental relic, no character or hands. High-end semi-realistic painted game item, detailed cold metal and translucent fractured ice, frosty cyan glow contained near the blade. Long blade, grip and pommel form ONE perfectly straight rigid axis; no bent sword, no disconnected hilt, preserve believable proportions. Entire sword including pommel and pedestal visible, frontal three-quarter product composition centered, 8 percent transparent margins, at least 1024 by 1024 square. Clear memorable silhouette in a small trophy slot, premium finish to match an ornate fantasy trophy collection. Blank small silver plaque on pedestal, no readable words, numbers or lettering; blade fantasy rune ornament may be abstract symbols only. Truly transparent background with alpha, no scenery, character, floor, fake checkerboard, card frame, UI, logo, watermark or unrelated props.
